Smooth warm pale grey limestone with broad subtle brush shading, soft bevels, clean legible joints, shadows from upper left; no photographic grain, marble veins, pores, dense cracks or aged/damaged stone. Slight softer edges on curled paper but clear silhouettes. No complete building, new post cap, tree, character, UI, text, frame or watermark.
